description: After-sales request management application for the SNCF Technicentre in Saint-Pierre-des-Corps. Built from design to deployment during a work-study program.
detail: Full business application (SAV_OPTER) handling the entire lifecycle of after-sales requests: creation, filtering by train set/region/status, planning of contradictory inspections and interventions, report (PV) validation. Multi-step workflow (plan inspection → complete inspection report → validate SAV handling → plan intervention → complete intervention report), with data split between SharePoint and Dataverse. Multiple user roles (SAV Manager, Account Manager, Client Manager, Administrator).
role: Developer on a 9-month work-study program within the RAC & Digital unit, from design to deployment, sole developer on the app, with regular presentations to the steering committee
contexte: Work-study program at the SNCF Technicentre in Saint-Pierre-des-Corps, November 2022 – August 2023.
resultats: Application deployed and used in production to track after-sales requests across multiple train sets and regions
Automated calculation of due dates accounting for business days and public holidays (Power Fx formulas)
Multi-step validation workflow with fine-grained user role management (SAV Manager, Account Manager, Client Manager)

description: Two business applications built for CARSAT Centre-Val de Loire on Power Platform: GCP Opposants (migration of a Java application to Power Apps) and OSMOSe (remote-work and part-time requests with an approval workflow).
detail: Two projects carried out in parallel on Microsoft Power Platform. GCP Opposants: migration of a legacy Java/SQL application to Power Apps for managing debtor accounts (treasuries, main revenue offices), backed by a SharePoint list of nearly 8,000 rows and an associated Active Directory migration. OSMOSe: application managing remote-work and part-time requests with a multi-level approval workflow (manager, division officer, HR) and automatic document generation.
role: Developer on a 12-month work-study program within the Regional IT Department (Digital Transformation Unit), working autonomously on two distinct business applications, from design to deployment
contexte: Work-study program at CARSAT Centre-Val de Loire, September 2024 – August 2025.
resultats: GCP Opposants: worked around SharePoint's delegation limit (2,000 rows) with a custom pagination system in Power Automate/Power Fx to process a list of nearly 8,000 items in full
GCP Opposants: successful migration from a legacy Java environment to Power Platform, including an associated Active Directory migration
OSMOSe: working multi-level approval workflow (manager → division officer → HR) with fine-grained SharePoint item-level permissions
OSMOSe: automatic document generation from a template via Power Automate

description: Collaborative fullstack web platform built by a team of 5. Microservices architecture with React, Java, MySQL, MongoDB and Docker.
detail: Team project (5 people): development of a fullstack web platform with React on the frontend and Java on the backend. Design and implementation of REST APIs, MySQL and MongoDB database management, microservices architecture, containerization and deployment with Docker. Collaborative work with Git.
role: Fullstack developer within a team of 5, responsible for part of the Java backend and REST APIs
contexte: Project carried out as part of my MIAGE degree, on a microservices architecture.
resultats: Docker containerization making team deployment easier

description: Collaborative web application built by a team of 3. Angular frontend, Spring Boot REST API, MongoDB database.
detail: Team project (3 people): development of a web application based on the Pandemic board game concept. Angular frontend design, Spring Boot REST API development, MongoDB database management. Client/server architecture, teamwork with Git, Trello and Discord.
role: Fullstack developer within a team of 3, responsible for the Angular frontend and part of the Spring Boot API
contexte: Project carried out as part of my MIAGE degree, based on the Pandemic board game concept as a collaborative web application.
resultats: Team project management with Trello and Discord
